title: Waymo restarts San Antonio service 5 months after flooding troubles | TechCrunch
summary: The resumed service in San Antonio will involve dozens of vehicles covering a 60-mile area that includes downtown and the San Antonio International Airport, according to the San Antonio Express-News , which was first to report on Waymo starting back up.
